_note: A JSON-RPC error answer to eth_estimateGas without revert data on a buy that may complete the curve: fallback true means the SDK sends with the 1.8M graduation gas limit; false means it is a provider rate limit (codes 429, -32005, -32029, or a message saying rate limit, too many requests or compute units) and the send fails as RPC_ERROR without sending.

cases.message: Your app has exceeded its compute units per second capacity
